punchline: At 141st in the world, Agassi went back to Challenger events, and eventually reached No. 1 again.
thirty_sec: In November 1997 Agassi fell to No. 141 and considered retiring. He went back to the Challenger Tour, reached the Las Vegas final and won in Burbank. On 5 July 1999 he was No. 1 again, and he had won the French Open that year.
question: Where could you step down to a smaller arena to collect real wins first?
key_contrast: He rebuilt at the level where winning was realistic.
